description: This file contains utility functions, class definitions, and mock implementations for DNS testing within the Chromium project, including building DNS response objects, mock DNS transaction classes, and test helpers.

classes.name: MockAddressSorter
classes.description: A mock implementation of AddressSorter that simply runs the callback with the provided endpoints.

classes.name: MockDnsClientRule::Result
classes.description: Represents the result of a mock DNS client rule, including response type, optional DNS response, and network error.

classes.name: MockDnsTransactionFactory::MockTransaction
classes.description: A mock DNS transaction class that simulates DNS responses based on predefined rules for testing purposes.

classes.name: MockDnsTransactionFactory::MockDohProbeRunner
classes.description: A mock DNS over HTTPS probe runner used in testing.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsRecord
methods.description: Constructs a DNS resource record with specified parameters.

methods.name: BuildTestCnameRecord
methods.description: Constructs a CNAME DNS resource record.

methods.name: BuildTestAddressRecord
methods.description: Constructs an A or AAAA DNS resource record based on IP address.

methods.name: BuildTestTextRecord
methods.description: Constructs a TXT DNS resource record with given text strings.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsAliasRecord
methods.description: Constructs an HTTPS alias DNS resource record.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceAlpnParam
methods.description: Creates an ALPN parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceEchConfigParam
methods.description: Creates an ECH config parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceMandatoryParam
methods.description: Creates a mandatory parameter list for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServicePortParam
methods.description: Creates a port parameter for HTTPS service records.

methods.name: BuildTestHttpsServiceRecord
methods.description: Constructs an HTTPS service DNS resource record with specified parameters.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsResponse
methods.description: Builds a DNS response with specified answer, authority, and additional records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsAddressResponse
methods.description: Builds a DNS response containing an address record.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsAddressResponseWithCname
methods.description: Builds a DNS response with address and CNAME records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsTextResponse
methods.description: Builds a DNS response with TXT records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsPointerResponse
methods.description: Builds a DNS response with PTR records.

methods.name: BuildTestDnsServiceResponse
methods.description: Builds a DNS response with SRV service records.

methods.name: CreateMalformedResponse
methods.description: Creates a malformed DNS response for testing.
